title: ggsegAAL
text: Figure 1: AAL1: cortical, subcortical, cerebellar components.  Figure 2: AAL1: cortical, subcortical, cerebellar components.  Figure 3: AAL1: cortical, subcortical, cerebellar components.
code: library(ggsegAAL) library(ggseg) library(ggplot2)  # Apply the original lookup-table colors using the atlas labels. # Keep the palette names unchanged (including lh_ and rh_ prefixes). plot_atlas_lut <- function(atlas) {   pal <- ggseg.formats::atlas_palette(atlas)   ggplot() +     ggseg::geom_brain(       atlas = atlas,       mapping = aes(fill = label),       show.legend = FALSE     ) +     scale_fill_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +     theme_void() +     theme(legend.position = "none") }  for (atlas in list(aal1_cortical(), aal1_subcortical(), aal1_cerebellum())) {   print(plot_atlas_lut(atlas)) }

title: ggsegAAL
text: ggseg3d_aal() helper uses Colin27 inflated meshes cortical representations can add translucent Colin27 pial surface anatomical context around subcortical cerebellar representations. Interactive 3D widgets embedded GitHub README; run examples interactive R session.
code: library(ggsegAAL)  ggseg3d_aal(aal3_cortical())  ggseg3d_aal(   aal3_subcortical(),   context = TRUE,   opacity = 0.15 )  ggseg3d_aal(   aal3_cerebellum(),   context = TRUE,   opacity = 0.15 )

title: ggsegAAL
text: original entry points remain available: Compatibility function names guarantee identical vertex geometry, polygon geometry, color palettes, region labels across major versions. Compare outputs reusing previously derived region-level results.
code: # Original cortical AAL atlas ggplot() + ggseg::geom_brain(atlas = aal()) + theme_void()  # AAL2 cortical atlas ggplot() + ggseg::geom_brain(atlas = aal2()) + theme_void()  # Existing AAL3 entry points for (atlas in list(aal3_cortical(), aal3_subcortical(), aal3_cerebellum())) {   print(     ggplot() +       ggseg::geom_brain(atlas = atlas) +       theme_void() +       theme(legend.position = "none")   ) }

title: Automated Anatomical Labeling atlases — aal_atlases
text: atlas provided three anatomical components: cortical: cortical atlas subcortical: subcortical atlas cerebellum: cerebellar atlas

title: Automated Anatomical Labeling atlases — aal_atlases
text: aal1_cortical(): AAL1 cortical atlas containing 82 cortical regions. aal1_subcortical(): AAL1 subcortical atlas containing 8 regions. aal1_cerebellum(): AAL1 cerebellar atlas containing 26 regions. aal2_cortical(): AAL2 cortical atlas containing 86 cortical regions, including AAL2 orbitofrontal parcellation. aal2_subcortical(): AAL2 subcortical atlas containing 8 regions. aal2_cerebellum(): AAL2 cerebellar atlas containing 26 regions. aal3_cortical(): AAL3 cortical atlas containing 90 cortical regions, including anterior cingulate subdivisions. aal3_subcortical(): AAL3 subcortical atlas containing 50 regions, including thalamic subdivisions. aal3_cerebellum(): AAL3 cerebellar atlas containing 26 regions. aal(): Backwards-compatible alias original AAL cortical atlas. aal2(): Backwards-compatible alias AAL2 cortical atlas.

title: Automated Anatomical Labeling atlases — aal_atlases
text: AAL1: 82 cortical + 8 subcortical + 26 cerebellar = 116 regions. AAL2: 86 cortical + 8 subcortical + 26 cerebellar = 120 regions. AAL3: 90 cortical + 50 subcortical + 26 cerebellar = 166 regions.
